interactive.description: Whether to start crmsh in interactive mode by default.

editor.description: Editor used when editing cluster resources or configuration interactively.

pager.description: Pager used for multi-page command output (e.g., 'more', 'less').

shell.description: Default shell invoked by crmsh for command execution (e.g., 'sh', 'bash').

history.description: Whether to persist command history to ~/.crm/shellhistory.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for interactive operations (e.g., resource operations).

lock_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for acquiring locks on cluster resources.

noconfirm.description: If true, skip confirmation prompts for dangerous operations (use with caution).

color.description: Enable colored output in terminal sessions (requires terminal support).

backupdir.description: Directory where crmsh stores automatic backups of the CIB.

plugins.description: List of crmsh plugins to load at startup. Each plugin may define its own options.

cluster_name.description: Default cluster name to use when operating on a single-cluster system. Empty to require explicit specification.

crm_cibsh.description: CIB source: 'live' (default, current live config), 'file:/path/to/file.xml' (read-only from file), or 'xml' (raw XML input).

crm_daemon_user.description: User account under which the Pacemaker daemon runs.

ocf_root.description: Root directory for OCF resource agents.

obscure_pattern.description: Pattern(s) to obscure sensitive values (e.g., 'passw*') when displaying configuration (supports regex-like patterns with wildcards).
